notes:
Fieldbook 1.4.4: summary work packages, dependency arrows, undo/redo

- Work packages with sub-activities take their dates from them (earliest start
  to latest finish), like MS Project summary tasks; optional "set by hand"
- Finish-to-start arrows for "Starts after" links; drag the dot at a bar's end
  onto another bar to link; "Link in order" for selected items; click an arrow
  to change the gap or remove the link; linked items are pushed automatically
- Undo / Redo buttons in the Plan tab and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y for your changes
- "Part of" / "Starts after" / work package lists follow the outline order
- New items get outline codes (WP3, 5.1, 1.2.3)
